newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Petkim workers get pay rises.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Petkim workers get pay rises.

text.p: The management of Turkey's state petrochemical producer Petkim signed a pay rise deal with 5,000 of its workers who will get at least 38 percent increases for the first half of this year, company officials said.
They said the agreement, retroactive from the beginning of the year, would also give the workers extra payments depending on their seniority.
In the second half of this year and onwards, the workers will get rises on a sliding scales scheme, which envisages inflation-indexed increases from July.

Petkim, which is slated for partial sell-off, employs about 5,500 workers, 3,300 of them at Aliaga plant and the rest at Izmit plant. Staff have staged a series of protests in recent months to demand higher wages.
